battle.name: 第六次反法同盟
battle.brief: 一八一三年春，普魯士、俄國、奧地利在德意志境內接戰，六戰六捷逼得拿破崙放棄萊比錫，戰火延燒到一八一四年的法國本土。萊比錫一役聯軍以數十萬兵力合圍法軍並切斷其退路。輪發槍在兩軍序列中早已退場，只餘於軍械庫舊藏與退伍老兵手中。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 協約國一方是六國聯盟：俄羅斯帝國、普魯士王國、奧地利帝國、大不列顛王國、瑞典王國、西班牙王國與葡萄牙王國，另有漢諾威等一批德意志邦國在內戰爆發後倒向聯軍。俄軍以巴爾克拉耶·德·托利的第一西方軍、布魯厄爾的第二西方軍與克魯森斯特恩的波羅的海艦隊為骨架，軍制仍保留俄式軍團與獨立炮兵團；普軍由布魯厄爾統合，指揮體系最為完整，含步兵、騎兵、炮兵、工兵與工兵支援的圍城分遣隊；奧軍以貝爾奈爾與施瓦岑貝格為主，兵員多為德意志籍與匈牙利籍，炮兵與輜重較弱；英軍由威靈頓公爵統帥，主要戰場在西班牙與比利牛斯，英軍的另一份力量是皇家海軍，負責封鎖法國海岸、護送聯軍在挪威的部隊與維持海上補給；瑞典軍由王儲貝納多特率領，與普軍聯合作戰，控制北翼。法國一方是法蘭西帝國及其盟國：義大利王國由歐仁·博哈奈斯指揮，率薩丁軍團與波隆那守軍；那不勒斯王國由若阿尚·穆雷；波蘭軍團由波拿波；萊茵同盟各邦（巴伐利亞、符騰堡、薩克森、威斯特伐利亞等）的輔助部隊亦隨法作戰。聯軍的最高指揮形式上歸於奧軍總帥施瓦岑貝格，實際決策分散在布魯厄爾、貝納多特、威靈頓各戰區；法軍的總指揮始終是拿破崙本人。
countriesEn: The side of the coalition was the alliance of six powers: the Russian Empire, the Kingdom of Prussia, the Austrian Empire, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, the Kingdom of Sweden, the Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal, with a number of German states, Hanover among them, turning to the coalition once the fighting had begun. The Russian army was built around Barclay de Tolly's First Western Army, Blücher's Second Western Army and Count Langeron's Baltic fleet; its structure still followed the Russian corps system with independent artillery brigades. The Prussian army was unified under Blücher and had the most complete command system of all, with infantry, cavalry, artillery, engineers and siege detachments. The Austrian army was led by Bellegarde and Schwarzenberg, was largely composed of German and Hungarian troops, and was weaker in artillery and train. The British army was commanded by the Duke of Wellington, fought mainly in Spain and along the Pyrenees, and contributed its other great strength in the Royal Navy, which blockaded the French coast, escorted the Allied troops in Norway and kept the sea supply line open. The Swedish army was led by the Crown Prince Bernadotte, fought alongside the Prussians, and held the northern flank. On the French side stood the French Empire and its satellites: the Kingdom of Italy under Eugène de Beauharnais, with the Sardinian corps and the garrison of Bologna; the Kingdom of Naples under Joachim Murat; the Polish corps under Poniatowski; and auxiliary contingents from the Confederation of the Rhine, Bavaria, Württemberg, Saxony and Westphalia among them. The nominal Allied high command belonged to Schwarzenberg, while actual decisions were taken in the separate theatres under Blücher, Bernadotte and Wellington. The French commander-in-chief remained Napoleon himself.
people: 拿破崙一世是整場戰爭的軸心。他自一八一三年春在波茨坦重建總參謀部，參謀長先後為貝爾蒂埃與貝爾納多特，元帥序列裡有穆雷、奈伊、維克托、達武、奧古斯特、莫蒂埃、麥克唐納與波拿波。一八一三年秋萊比錫之圍中各路法軍節節敗退，波拿波在撤退途中中流彈重傷，一八一四年二月在巴黎去世，未能回到故國。聯軍方面，普軍元帥布魯厄爾是整場戰爭的突擊核心：他率普軍在萊比錫北面打贏莫克恩夜戰，一八一四年三月率軍進入巴黎；俄軍元帥巴爾克拉耶·德·托利與奧軍元帥施瓦岑貝格在東線與巴伐利亞作戰，後者指揮聯軍主力沿維也納盆地西進；俄軍元帥維特根斯坦在德國南部獨當一面。英國方面，威靈頓公爵於一八一三年率聯軍攻入西班牙，取下巴斯克與加泰隆尼亞的要塞，封鎖法國海岸；瑞典王儲貝納多特在北翼指揮瑞典軍與漢堡軍團，參與莫克恩與萊比錫之戰。聯軍後方還有兩位不穿軍服的人：奧地利首相梅特涅與駐維也納的卡塞爾伯爵，他們把聯軍的軍事勝利轉成了一份政治決議——一八一三年十月的《庫爾姆宣言》，宣佈拿破崙本人為歐洲公敵，把戰爭目標由法國的疆界改寫成對法國體系的顛覆。伊利亞特夫人在萊比錫的傷兵營裏照顧聯軍將士，薩凡尼被西班牙人視為解放者。
peopleEn: Napoleon I was the axis of the whole war. From the spring of 1813 he rebuilt his general staff at Potsdam, with Berthier and then Bernadotte as chief of staff, and around him sat the marshals Murat, Ney, Victor, Davout, Augereau, Mortier, Macdonald and Poniatowski. In the encirclement of Leipzig in the autumn of 1813 the French armies were beaten one after another, and Poniatowski was mortally wounded by a stray bullet while withdrawing; he died in Paris in February 1814 without seeing his country again. On the Allied side the Prussian field marshal Blücher was the striking core of the entire war: he won the night action at Möckern north of Leipzig and entered Paris in March 1814. The Russian field marshal Barclay de Tolly and the Austrian field marshal Schwarzenberg fought in the east and in Bavaria, the latter commanding the main Allied body as it advanced west along the Vienna basin, while the Russian field marshal Wittgenstein operated independently in southern Germany. For Britain, the Duke of Wellington led the Allied armies into Spain in 1813, took the fortresses of the Basque country and Catalonia, and blockaded the French coast. The Swedish Crown Prince Bernadotte commanded the Swedish and Hamburg corps on the northern flank and took part in Möckern and at Leipzig. Two people without uniforms stood behind the coalition: Metternich, the Austrian chancellor, and Count Castlereagh, the British envoy at Vienna, who turned a military victory into a political instrument — the Declaration of Kalisch of October 1813, which named Napoleon the enemy of Europe and rewrote the war aim from the boundaries of France to the destruction of the French system. Madame de Staël nursed the Allied wounded in the hospitals of Leipzig, and San Martín was received in Spain as a liberator.
kits: 輪發槍在這場戰爭裡的位置是「軍械庫裡的遺物」，已完全退出野戰序列。輪發機制是最早的後膛自擊發手槍方案，代價是零件昂貴、組裝耗時，機簧在潮濕或低溫中點火遲緩；到一八一三至一八一四年，歐洲各國野戰部隊一律使用燧發手槍——法軍是葛里波瓦爾系統的單發燧發手槍與後膛裝填的騎兵手槍，英軍是葛里波瓦爾之前的英式燧發手槍與新改良的騎兵手槍，奧軍、俄軍與普軍大致沿用同類裝備。真正決定會戰結果的是制式步槍：法軍為滑膛安十式（一七七七年型、一八○三年改進）與一八一一式十二發滑膛燧發步槍，英軍為一八○二年式的褐貝絲滑膛燧發步槍，普軍為一八○九年式燧發步槍，奧軍為一八○七年式燧發步槍，俄軍為一八○七年式燧發步槍並以紙包定裝藥取代散裝火藥。炮兵方面是法軍葛里波瓦爾四磅、六磅與十二磅野戰炮，英軍七磅臼炮與一七七○年式的榴彈炮，普奧俄各自的標準炮隊；攻城器材包括便攜浮橋、壕溝工具、雲梯、配重攻城塔與齊射攻城炮。輔助兵種方面，聯軍大量使用工程兵架橋、掘壕與架設攻城炮塔，英軍的攻城分遣隊甚至配備了可分解重量的攻城砲；後勤上則是數以萬計的貨車、帳篷、火藥車、輜重車與每兵約四十磅的背囊。真正左右萊比錫的，是聯軍的炮兵集中與法軍的馬匹——一八一三年整個秋季拿破崙的騎兵在補充與疲勞之間周旋，德國境內的草料與馬廄被聯軍先行徵用，法軍的偵察騎兵到後期已難成建制地作戰。輪發槍偶爾出現於退伍老兵私人珍藏、王室軍械庫陳列與軍官儀仗用途，維也納與斯德哥爾摩的軍械庫至今仍保存數件十六、十七世紀的輪發手槍樣品。
kitsEn: The wheellock's place in this war was as an object in the armoury, wholly removed from the order of battle. The wheellock action is the earliest self-igniting breech-loading pistol system, and its costs are high: expensive parts, slow assembly, and a spring-driven igniter that hung or misfired in wet or freezing weather. By 1813 and 1814 every field army in Europe used flintlock pistols — the French had the single-shot Gribeauval pistol and the rear-loading cavalry pistol, the British had their flintlock pistols and the newly improved cavalry patterns, and the Austrian, Russian and Prussian armies used comparable types. What actually decided the battles was the regulation musket: the French smoothbored An XI, that is the 1777 pattern as revised in 1803, and the 1811-pattern twelve-shot smoothbore flintlock; the British the 1802-pattern Brown Bess smoothbore flintlock; the Prussians the 1809-pattern flintlock musket; the Austrians the 1807-pattern flintlock musket; and the Russians the 1807-pattern flintlock musket, firing paper cartridges in place of loose powder. The artillery was the French Gribeauval four-, six- and twelve-pounders, the British seven-pounder howitzers and the 1770-pattern bombs, and the standard batteries of Prussia, Austria and Russia. Siege equipment included portable pontoon bridges, trench tools, ladders, counterweight towers and batteries of ricochet guns. The engineers did the unglamorous work, bridging rivers, entrenching and assembling siege batteries, and the British siege trains even travelled with guns that could be broken down into loads. The logistic train consisted of tens of thousands of wagons, tents, ammunition carts, baggage wagons and infantry knapsacks of some forty pounds. What really decided Leipzig was the concentration of Allied artillery and the French horses: through the autumn of 1813 Napoleon's cavalry was worn down between replacement and exhaustion, and the forage and stables of Germany were taken by the Allies first, so that by the end French reconnaissance cavalry could hardly operate as a formed body. The wheellock survived only in the private collections of retired soldiers, in royal armoury displays and as an officer's parade sidearm; the armouries of Vienna and Stockholm still hold several sixteenth- and seventeenth-century wheellock pistols.
tactics: 聯軍的戰術核心是多路合圍與戰略迂迴。一八一三年二月，聯軍放棄對維爾納的正面強攻，改採三路縱隊同時壓進德國：布魯厄爾的普軍沿中線推進，貝納多特的瑞典與漢堡軍團在北面展開，俄軍在東面威脅巴伐利亞方向，使法軍首尾不能相顧。拿破崙在萊比錫反攻，五月初的路維希一役與五月二十日至二十一日的包岑一役都是正面拉鋸，法軍未能切斷普軍縱隊，反而在包岑的施普雷河漲水中屢攻不克。戰略主動權逐步轉到聯軍手上：八月十九日至二十日的德累斯登一役，聯軍以縱隊與退卻消耗法軍主力的企圖被拿破崙的側翼反擊挫敗，但法軍也未能消滅聯軍主力；八月二十九日至三十日的庫爾姆一役，拿破崙以海爾費爾德縱隊奇襲維特根斯坦的聯軍側翼得手，卻因兵力不足無法把戰果擴大。十月十六日至十九日的萊比錫會戰是整場戰爭的頂點：聯軍以巴爾克萊與德·托利率俄普兩軍在北面施壓，施瓦岑貝格與本尼森在南部主攻，別尼森在克奈與默爾齊希兩處渡口遏止法軍退路，英普混合支隊在萊比錫西側拖住法軍右翼，拿破崙屢次中央突破均未奏效，撤退時又因艾爾斯特橋被過早炸毀而丟下大批輜重與火炮。一八一四年聯軍三路入法：貝納多特自東北、普軍主力沿比爾松河推進、奧軍主力經瑞士越過阿爾卑斯山自東南逼近，三支大軍在巴黎城下會合，法軍的退路與補給線被完全切斷。
tacticsEn: The core of Allied method was multi-axis convergence and strategic encirclement. In February 1813 the coalition gave up the frontal assault on Vilna and advanced into Germany in three columns at once: Blücher's Prussians pushed along the centre, Bernadotte's Swedish and Hamburg corps spread out to the north, and the Russians threatened Bavaria from the east, so that the French could not bring their forces to bear on any one sector. Napoleon counter-attacked at Leipzig. The action at Lützen in early May and the battle of Bautzen from 20 to 21 May were both frontal struggles in which the French failed to cut the Prussian columns, and at Bautzen the swollen Spree river made repeated frontal attacks fail. The strategic initiative passed gradually to the coalition. In the battle of Dresden from 19 to 26 August the Allied plan of wearing the French main body down by marching in columns and withdrawing was checked by Napoleon's flank counter-stroke, but the French could not destroy the Allied main body either. At Kulm from 29 to 30 August Napoleon caught Wittgenstein's flank with the corps of Heudelet and won the action, but lacked the strength to enlarge the success. The battle of Leipzig from 16 to 19 October 1813 was the climax of the whole war. Barclay de Tolly and Blücher pressed from the north with the Russian and Prussian armies, Schwarzenberg and Benigsen attacked from the south, Bülow sealed the Kna and Merzig crossings that covered the French line of retreat, and a mixed British-Prussian detachment held the French right on the western side of the city. Napoleon's repeated central penetrations failed, and in the withdrawal the premature destruction of the Elster bridge cost the French a large part of their trains and guns. In 1814 the coalition entered France by three routes: Bernadotte from the north-east, the main Prussian body along the Biesche, and the Austrian main body across the Alps by Switzerland from the south-east, the three converging before Paris while the French lines of communication and supply were cut completely.
data: 萊比錫會戰是拿破崙時代規模最大的會戰之一：聯軍方面的出動兵力通常估計為四十九萬至五十四萬，法軍約十九萬至二十萬。傷亡數字各家說法不一，聯軍方面的死傷常被估為五萬至六萬，法軍損失約三萬八千至五萬，其中奈伊麾下損失最重，超過二萬二千人；會戰之後法軍被奪走或損失的火炮逾一百五十門。炮兵密度上，聯軍在多處戰線同時集中上百門火炮，形成所謂的「胸膛射擊」。一八一三年五月路維希之戰，聯軍與法軍雙方損失各在數千人上下；八月的德累斯登一役，聯軍兵力約十一萬，法軍約十萬，法軍損失約二萬二千至三萬五千人，聯軍損失約一萬至一萬二千人；同月二十九日至三十日的庫爾姆之戰，聯軍以四萬至四萬五千人對法軍約二萬五千人，法軍損失約五千至一萬人，聯軍損失約五千人，其中俄軍第二西方軍有數百人被俘。十月三十日的哈瑙之戰，聯軍約三萬人對法軍約四萬五千人，法軍損失約八千至一萬二千人，聯軍損失約一千二百至五千人。拿破崙的戰爭債務在晚年自述中估為數億法郎，聯軍在德意志境內的糧秣與軍需則靠英國海運與奧地利產糧區供應，普軍與奧軍的野戰軍合計在四十萬上下。一八一四年的巴黎攻略，聯軍集結約十二萬人，法軍在拉姆布與塞夫爾一線的守軍約一萬二千至一萬四千人。
dataEn: Leipzig was among the largest battles of the Napoleonic age: the Allied force is usually put at four hundred and ninety to five hundred and forty thousand men against one hundred and ninety to two hundred thousand French. The casualty figures are disputed; Allied dead and wounded are commonly given as fifty to sixty thousand and French losses as thirty-eight to fifty thousand, the heaviest of them falling on Ney's command with more than twenty-two thousand men. Over one hundred and fifty French guns were lost or captured. On the artillery density, the Allies massed more than a hundred pieces on several fronts at once, producing what was called the enfilade of the chest. At Lützen in May 1813 losses ran into the thousands on each side. At Dresden from 19 to 26 August the Allies had about one hundred and ten thousand men against roughly one hundred thousand French, with French losses of some twenty-two to thirty-five thousand and Allied losses of around ten to twelve thousand. At Kulm on 29 and 30 August the Allies numbered forty to forty-five thousand against some twenty-five thousand French, with French losses of five to ten thousand and Allied losses near five thousand, including several hundred Russians captured. At Hanau on 30 October about thirty thousand Allies faced some forty-five thousand French, the French losing eight to twelve thousand and the Allies between twelve hundred and five thousand. Napoleon's war debts are estimated by him in later years at hundreds of millions of francs, while the Allied armies in Germany drew their grain and stores from British seaborne supply and the Austrian breadbasket, the Prussian and Austrian field armies together numbering on the order of four hundred thousand men. For the assault on Paris in 1814 the coalition concentrated about one hundred and twenty thousand men against a French defence line from Rambouillet to Sèvres numbering some twelve to fourteen thousand.
cause: 打起來的原因是三層疊加的。第一層是蘇俄與普魯士的報復：拿破崙一八一二年的入侵俄國把整個歐洲逼到對立面，莫斯科的失敗讓亞歷山大一世自居「被侮辱的歐洲」的復仇者，普魯士則在一八一二年初已暗中倒戈，與法軍在俄普邊境交火。第二層是拿破崙自己在德意志的行為：他不肯接受俄普之間的和約，把戰爭帶進德意志腹地，奪回漢堡等要地，收復的每一座城市都讓他成為德意志邦國主權的直接破壞者——這正是梅特涅在回憶錄裡強調的「萊比錫之前的那些戰役，其實是拿破崙自己挑起來的」。第三層是制度性的：拿破崙把徵兵、土地與資源大量轉移給法國的盟國，把德意志變成法國的後方與稅源；維也納會議後的歐洲均勢需要一個共同的外部敵人來維持奧地利與普魯士在德意志的位勢，而拿破崙的體系正好提供了這個敵人。聯軍之所以能成形，還得力於英國的外交與補貼：一八一三年初英國與俄、普、奧、西、葡、瑞典共同簽署大型同盟條約，以-subsidies維持歐陸聯軍的補給，讓多國聯軍不必各自承擔財政。深層背景則是西班牙半島的抵抗仍牽制著法軍數萬兵馬，使法國在歐陸無法集中全部兵力，聯軍才得以在東線與西線同時開闢戰場。
causeEn: The war came about through three overlapping causes. The first was Russian and Prussian revenge. Napoleon's invasion of Russia in 1812 turned all of Europe against him, and the failure at Moscow allowed Alexander I to present himself as the avenger of a humiliated Europe, while Prussia had already turned against France in the opening months of 1812 and fought along the Russo-Prussian frontier. The second was Napoleon's own conduct in Germany: refusing to accept a peace between Russia and Prussia, carrying the war into the belly of Germany, and seizing Hamburg and other strongholds, so that every town he retook made him the direct violator of the sovereignty of the German states — the point Metternich pressed in his memoirs, that the battles before Leipzig were in truth wars of Napoleon's own making. The third was structural. Napoleon had transferred conscripts, land and revenue to his satellites and turned Germany into a French hinterland and tax base; the European settlement created at Vienna needed a common external enemy to preserve the position of Austria and Prussia in Germany, and the Napoleonic system supplied exactly that enemy. The coalition could take shape only because of British diplomacy and British subsidies: the large allied treaties of early 1813 among Britain, Russia, Prussia, Austria, Spain, Portugal and Sweden kept the continental armies supplied without each power having to bear the cost alone. Beneath all of it, the Spanish resistance still pinned tens of thousands of French troops on the peninsula, so that France could not concentrate on one front in Europe and the coalition was able to open theatres in the east and the west at the same time.
impact: 直接後果是拿破崙體系的崩潰與歐洲秩序的重整。一八一四年三月聯軍進入巴黎，拿破崙退位並被流放至厄爾巴島；波旁王朝復辟，維也納會議召開並重劃歐洲疆界，法國的邊界退回一七九二年的線上，其後約半個世紀的相對和平由此開始，直到一八二○年代希臘戰爭與一八三○年革命的震動。軍事上，這場戰爭把多國協同的經驗寫進制度：聯合參謀部、情報共享、固定補給線與集中炮兵，都被各國軍隊吸收，成為十九世紀盟軍作戰的模板；俄國自此由戰國邊陲升格為歐洲大國，亞歷山大一世的「歐洲解放者」形象隨《庫爾姆宣言》而定型。工業與技術層面，一八一三至一八一四年的戰役推動了鐵路運輸的軍事試用，德國境內的鐵路在戰時被軍隊應急徵用，後勤史由此翻過一頁。制度與秩序層面，維也納會議確立的「權力平衡」與「正統主義」成為歐洲外交的框架達四十年，直到一八四八年的革命把整個體系掀翻。間接的長遠影響在美洲與亞洲：拿破崙帝國崩潰使西班牙在美洲的殖民統治出現真空，直接推動一八一六年起的拉丁美洲獨立運動；英國在歐洲大陸的戰事結束後被迫收縮全球兵力，其在印度的帝國管理在此後數十年暴露出軍力不足的結構性問題，一八五七年的印度起義正是這份收縮的後果。文化上，萊比錫在德語世界成為「民族大會戰」的代號，十九世紀的歷史畫與文學不斷重繪那四天的街壘與城郊戰。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was the collapse of the Napoleonic system and a redrawing of the European order. The coalition entered Paris in March 1814, Napoleon abdicated and was exiled to Elba, the Bourbons were restored, and the Congress of Vienna met and redrew the map of Europe, returning France to its 1792 borders and opening roughly half a century of relative peace until the Greek war of the 1820s and the revolutions of 1830 shook the arrangement. Militarily, the war wrote multi-national cooperation into doctrine: a combined staff, shared intelligence, fixed supply lines and massed artillery all passed into the practice of nineteenth-century coalition warfare and became its template. Russia moved from the margin of the conflict to the position of a great European power, and Alexander I's image as the liberator of Europe was fixed by the Declaration of Kalisch. On the industrial side, the campaigns of 1813 and 1814 forced the first military uses of railways, with German lines being taken over by the armies, and logistics was never the same again. On the institutional side, the balance of power and the doctrine of legitimacy fixed at Vienna framed European diplomacy for four decades, until the revolutions of 1848 overturned the whole structure. The longer indirect effects ran across the Atlantic and Asia: the collapse of the Napoleonic empire left a vacuum in Spanish colonial rule and drove the Latin American independence movements that began in 1816, and the British, freed from continental war, contracted their global military effort, leaving the empire structurally short of troops in India — a shortage that showed itself decades later in the rising of 1857. Culturally, Leipzig became in the German world a synonym for the battle of the nations, and nineteenth-century history painting and literature returned again and again to those four days of barricades and fighting in the suburbs.
result: 結果是拿破崙第一次退位與法國的軍事失敗。一八一四年一月二十五日法軍在奧布河與奧爾河交會處被迫退過萊茵；聯軍三軍在二月初越過萊茵，二十七日進軍凡爾登，二月十八日在蒙特羅擊敗麥克隆與內伊殘部，三月二十六日至二十七日克拉奧涅一役，奈伊第六軍在設防的村落裡頂住聯軍第五軍的連續攻擊，一八一四年三月三十日聯軍進入巴黎，莫蒂埃在聖克盧投降。蒙馬爾的馬奇昂師首先叛變，巴黎隨即陷落。四月六日拿破崙在巴黎簽署退位詔書；四月十一日《楓丹白露條約》把法國限制在一八一四年的邊界內，並允許其保留約十萬兵力的常備軍，波旁王朝的第一王國於是復辟。拿破崙被送往厄爾巴島，島上隨行武裝被限制在一千人上下，其後因策劃再起，於一八一五年十月被轉移至聖赫勒拿島。一八一五年百日王朝在滑鐵盧一役被聯軍擊敗，拿破崙二次退位，維也納會議最終確認了新歐洲的邊界。技術上，這幾年也把戰爭推到另一個階段：野戰砲的射程與精度提高、步兵以滑膛燧發步槍構成的密集縱深線性列陣達到頂點，而輪發槍這類十六世紀的後膛手槍，已經整整四百年不曾再出現在任何一次決定勝負的交火裡，只在軍械庫的角落與退伍老兵的家中作為舊日的證物存留。
resultEn: The result was Napoleon's first abdication and the military defeat of France. On 25 January 1814 the French were forced back across the Rhine at the junction of the Aube and the Aujon; the three Allied armies crossed the Rhine in early February, entered Verdun on the 27th, defeated the remnants of Moncey and Ney at Montereau on 18 February, and at Craonne from 26 to 27 February saw Ney's VI Corps hold off repeated attacks by the V Corps from behind the defences of the village. On 30 March 1814 the coalition entered Paris, and Mortier capitulated at Saint-Cloud. Marmont's Maicion's division was among the first to defect, and the city fell at once. On 6 April Napoleon signed the act of abdication at Paris; the Treaty of Fontainebleau of 11 April restricted France to its 1814 borders and allowed it a peacetime establishment of some one hundred and ten thousand men, and the First Bourbon Kingdom was restored. Napoleon was sent to Elba with his armed escort limited to around a thousand men, and after his attempt to resume power was moved to Saint Helena in October 1815. The Hundred Days ended at Waterloo in 1815 with a second abdication, and the Congress of Vienna finally settled the boundaries of the new Europe. On the technical side these years carried warfare into another phase: the range and accuracy of field artillery rose, the dense linear battle line built on smoothbore flintlock muskets reached its highest development, and a sixteenth-century breech-loading pistol such as the wheellock had not appeared in a single exchange of fire that decided anything for four hundred years. It survived only in the corner of an armoury and in the homes of retired soldiers, as evidence of a former age.
